# Vision Capture AI Documentation

Welcome to the Vision Capture documentation for AI agents and LLMs. 
Vision Capture is India's premier AI data collection company, specializing in high-quality egocentric data for Physical AI, robotics, and embodied intelligent systems.

## About Us
We empower the future of Embodied AI and Robotics with high-quality, large-scale dataset collection tailored for Foundation Models and Generative AI.
